chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from al-ʿAbbās, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, who said:

Abū Ḥārith asked him about a man who performed tamattuʿ with the ʿumrah up to the hajj, then performed tawaf, saʿy, and taqsir: is the tawaf al-nisāʾ required upon him? He said: No. Tawaf al-nisāʾ is only after returning from Minā.

key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ: the minor pilgrimage performed before hajj in tamattuʿ
key_terms.تَمَتَّعَ: performed tamattuʿ, the hajj form combining ʿumrah with hajj
key_terms.سَعَى: performed saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah
key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf required for the lawfulness of marital relations after pilgrimage rites
key_terms.قَصَّرَ: shortened the hair, completing the state transition after ʿumrah
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the sacred site to which pilgrims go during hajj rites

ai.seo_question: When is tawaf al-nisāʾ required in hajj al-tamattuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hajj al-tamattuʿ. It states that tawaf al-nisāʾ is not performed after the ʿumrah portion of tamattuʿ, but rather after returning from Minā during the hajj rites.
